import numpy as np
t=df['t'].values; A=df['A'].values; y=df['dA_dt'].values
for lo in np.arange(0.5,10,1.0):
    m=(t>=lo)&(t<lo+1.0)
    if m.sum()<10: continue
    best=None
    for p in np.arange(0.5,4.01,0.25):
        X=np.column_stack([np.ones(m.sum()),A[m]**p])
        c=np.linalg.lstsq(X,y[m],rcond=None)[0]
        r=np.sum((X@c-y[m])**2)
        if best is None or r<best[0]: best=(r,p,c)
    # also quadratic-in-A poly for comparison
    X=np.column_stack([np.ones(m.sum()),A[m],A[m]**2,A[m]**3]); c3=np.linalg.lstsq(X,y[m],rcond=None)[0]
    r3=np.sum((X@c3-y[m])**2)
    print(f"t[{lo:.1f},{lo+1:.1f}) n={m.sum()} p={best[1]} a={best[2][0]:.3f} b={best[2][1]:.3f} rss={best[0]:.4f} cubic rss={r3:.4f} coeffs={np.round(c3,3)}")
